profile.headline: Math and probabilistic methods for machine learning
profile.summary:
I'm a recovering mathematician who has had the good fortune of working with some statistics and machine learning experts.  Right now I'm interested in research scientist roles, away from the leadership and engineering roles I've had in the past.

Note that, for family reasons I strongly prefer to be mostly located in San Francisco.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Bayesian methods, generative models, Tensorflow probability

positions.title: Unemployed
positions.description: Taking a break to recharge, reassess, and manage some family issues.

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.description: First hire, initially as Principal Engineer reporting to CTO.  Helped design and implement infrastructure and automation for deep learning.  Contributed to hyperparameter search, GPU cluster manager, and web UI.  Promoted to VP of Engineering, managed engineering team; recruited and mentored engineers, installed engineering and recruiting process.  Assisted with product strategy, recruiting, customer success, and marketing.

positions.title: Head of Software
positions.description:
First research hire, initial title was Research Post-doc ("Intern") reporting to the Chief Investment Officer; later promoted to Senior Member of Research Staff.  Developed statistical machine learning models and infrastructure for automated trading.  Research contributions include impact models, risk models, portfolio planners, and pricing models for multiple asset classes and regions.  Software contributions include back-testing systems, data infrastructure, ETL pipelines, and optimizations for portfolio planners and mathematical primitives.  Played important role in recruiting, hiring and mentoring research, software, and IT staff.

Served as Acting VP of Engineering to oversee development of v2 live trading system from recruiting the first engineer through production deployment.  Managed IT team, and made key hardware decisions for compute cluster, and assisted in search for VP Eng role.  Returned to Principal Member of Research Staff role to lead development of a new strategy product team.  Promoted to Head of Software to oversee v2 research infrastructure initiative.  Served as software hiring manager and assisted with hiring leadership roles like Head of Recruiting and COO.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description: Taught calculus.  Advised undergraduate reading project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineering for an online marketplace for services.  Also created and managed first QA team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Development of internal tool for PC part data management for the pcOrder.com subsidiary.
